prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vintage scene set in a dimly lit, wood-paneled room, centered on an old-fashioned CRT television displaying static "snow" on its screen. The TV, a classic model with a boxy shape and dark casing, sits atop a polished wooden cabinet. To the left of the television, a small stack of books and papers is partially visible, adding a touch of lived-in realism. On the right side of the cabinet, a retro green desk lamp with a rounded shade and a small black speaker or electronic device complete the arrangement. The lighting is soft and moody, casting gentle shadows and evoking a nostalgic, late-20th-century atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by warm browns, muted greens, and the cool blue-white glow of the TV static, creating a cinematic, almost melancholic mood. The composition is straightforward, with the camera positioned at eye level and focused directly on the television, using a shallow depth of field to subtly blur the background and draw attention to the central subject. The overall style is reminiscent of a still from a period drama or a retro-inspired film, capturing a quiet, contemplative moment frozen in time.
